name: openkline
description: A framework-independent, extensible financial chart engine.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:react:browser:unlocked: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_OUTPUT_DIR=artifacts/playwright-results-react playwright test --config playwright.react.config.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:react:production:unlocked: npm run build && npm --prefix examples/nextjs-app-router run build && PLAYWRIGHT_OUTPUT_DIR=artifacts/playwright-results-react-production playwright test --config playwright.react.production.config.ts --project=chromium-production
scripts.test:market-replay: npm run build && npm exec -- tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test-dist/tests/market-replay-tape.test.js test-dist/tests/market-replay-controller.test.js test-dist/tests/market-replay-coordinator.test.js test-dist/tests/market-replay-workspace.test.js test-dist/tests/market-replay-causality.test.js
scripts.package:check: npm run build && NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/openkline-npm-cache npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
scripts.preview:prepare: npm run build && node scripts/preview-candidate.mjs prepare
scripts.preview:verify: npm run build && node scripts/preview-candidate.mjs verify
